# frozen_string_literal: true

class LinkPolicy
  def self.external?(url)
    uri = URI.parse(url)
    local = URI.parse("#{Rails.configuration.x.use_https ? 'https' : 'http'}://#{Rails.configuration.x.local_domain}")

    !(uri.host&.casecmp?(local.host) && uri.port == local.port)
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError

  end
end

- **Unparseable input and URLs with no host (such as `mailto:`) return `true`.** An empty string also returns `true`.

# frozen_string_literal: true

class LinkPolicy
  def self.external?(url)
    uri = Addressable::URI.parse(url)
    return true if uri.nil?

    local = Addressable::URI.parse("//#{Rails.configuration.x.local_domain}")

    uri.normalized_host != local.normalized_host || uri.port != local.port
  rescue Addressable::URI::InvalidURIError
    true
  end
end
